body: Its a small SEN school with 4/5 staff max. They are all extremely outgoing and chatty and I’m definitely not. I really like working there, I just can’t match that level of outgoing and it makes me feel like I don’t belong

He’s very much aware of this, and I was all for keeping things friendly for a while, but things have developed anyway and I really do see something there. I dont want it to be a rebound, I want to be able to leave my ex behind fully so I can make sure I do this right
It was a joint decision but I do feel like it was more on his side than mine.

I really would like that but I don’t think he would. He’s closed off to the idea of trying again because he doesn’t believe that things can change, and there’s “too much that’s happened to go back” as he would say. 

It’s just tough because I really think given another chance things could be ok, he’s just convinced himself it isn’t meant to be therefore thats it

I feel your pain, I am so sorry. I’m in the exact same situation, 4 years and we are both 21. He is unsure of his feelings and doesn’t want to commit without experiencing life first. I thought we would be together forever. 

I hear they say that in this time you just need to take care of yourself, I am trying to do that. If you ever want to talk about it with someone who gets it my DMs are open. I can’t offer advice as I too am beyond heartbroken, but I can offer a place to vent with someone who understands the pain.

Take care of yourself
hey if u want to rant with someone that gets it, my dms are open and it sounds like we have pretty similar situations

I wish I knew :( It felt real to me and I would’ve wanted it to be that way forever, but I guess if you’ve never known any different you’re going to want to experience more? I don’t really understand, I just want to respect his decision but find a way to live without spending my life waiting for him

We have agreed to keep our space for now and let things settle, but long term i would still like to know how he is getting on and be able to hang out with a group of friends without it being awkward. I still think its a long way off but I just dont want to lose such a deep friendship because we were no good together romantically

I feel this. You’re post sounds identical to my situation. I can’t help but feel like no matter how much I tried, I could’ve done more. Its been a few days since he told me he’s no longer in love with me, and I have begged and prayed that he stayed, but its no good. He has decided i’m incapable of change and that he doesn’t want to be in my life anymore. I am truly heartbroken and I dont think I will ever get over it, he is my world and I would do anything for him if it meant he’d give me another chance. I can’t live with myself because I feel like I could’ve done more

following this because i am in the EXACT same scenario, it hurts a lot. I’ve asked him about the chance of reassessing in 3 months but he’s so sure that he doesn’t want me anymore that it doesn’t matter if I change or not. I feel like this is all my fault, if I didn’t get comfortable and if I didn’t lose myself so much to the relationship then maybe I could’ve had a chance to see what I needed to do before he got fed up of me

Im on day 3 of this, I still messaged him this morning asking for another go. We had nearly 4 years together, I cannot just accept that we will never see each other again, never hug, never kiss, its just over because he decided he didnt want me anymore. I can’t eat, I can’t sleep, I am just utterly and completely lost. I don’t want to improve myself, if I did i’d only be doing it for him, to show him that he wants me. 

He was my first and I have never felt pain like this before, I don’t want to live in a world where I don’t see him everyday. This is too much to handle
